quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: Patient says: "I've had this recurring pressure in my chest that comes and goes with no clear pattern, and I get winded doing things that used to be easy."
quests.hint: One symptom is a feeling in the chest, and the other is about breathing during activity.
quests.explanation: Recurring chest pressure is Chest Pain, and getting winded easily is Shortness of Breath.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: The doctor asks the patient to describe their pain, and the patient says: "It's a burning sensation that starts in my chest and creeps up into my throat, worse when I lie down after eating, and I've also had a hoarse voice most mornings."
quests.hint: The burning rising up to the throat is more precise than simple chest burning alone.
quests.explanation: Burning that rises to the throat is Acid Reflux, a more precise term, plus the separate symptom Hoarse Voice.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: "My knees have been catching and locking up when I try to straighten them fully, and there's a grinding feeling too, and my lower back has been sore from compensating," the patient tells the doctor.
quests.hint: One symptom is centered in the knees, and the other is a separate result in the back.
quests.explanation: Catching and locking in the knees is Knee Pain, and the resulting ache is Back Pain.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: At the clinic, the patient says: "I've been getting these waves of heat that spread up from my chest to my face, several times a day, and they leave me drenched."
quests.hint: One symptom is the wave of heat itself, and the other is what it causes.
quests.explanation: Sudden waves of heat during the day are Hot Flashes, and being drenched afterward is Excessive Sweating.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: During the check-up, the patient explains: "My concentration has really slipped at work, and I've also had trouble falling asleep even when I'm exhausted."
quests.hint: One symptom is about focus during the day, and the other is about falling asleep at night.
quests.explanation: Slipping concentration is Brain Fog, and trouble falling asleep despite exhaustion is Insomnia.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: "My hands have felt a bit weaker than usual these past few days, and I've had some stiffness in my fingers in the morning," the patient tells the doctor.
quests.hint: One symptom is about strength, and the other is about morning stiffness in the joints.
quests.explanation: Weaker hands point to Weakness, and morning stiffness in the fingers is Joint Stiffness.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: Patient says: "I've had this nagging cough that's worse at night, and it's been keeping me from getting a full night's sleep."
quests.hint: One symptom is the cough itself, and the other is its effect on sleep.
quests.explanation: A cough worse at night is Cough, and the resulting disrupted sleep is Insomnia.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: The doctor asks about recent changes, and the patient says: "My skin has been noticeably drier than usual, especially on my shins, and I've felt the cold more than everyone else in my house."
quests.hint: One symptom is about skin texture, and the other is about feeling cold more than others.
quests.explanation: Drier skin than usual is Dry Skin, and feeling cold more than others is Chills.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: "I've had some on-and-off swelling in my ankles by the end of the day, and I've also had some mild back pain from being on my feet all day," the patient tells the doctor.
quests.hint: One symptom is in the ankles by evening, and the other is in the back from standing.
quests.explanation: Evening swelling is Swollen Ankles, and soreness from standing all day is Back Pain.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: At the clinic, the patient says: "I've had this gnawing discomfort in my stomach a few hours after meals, and antacids don't seem to help much anymore, and I've also felt bloated most of the day."
quests.hint: One symptom is discomfort a few hours after eating, and the other is fullness throughout the day.
quests.explanation: Gnawing discomfort after meals is a Stomach Ache, and all-day fullness is Bloating.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: During the check-up, the patient explains: "My hearing seems fine day to day, but I've started asking people to repeat themselves in noisy rooms specifically, and I've also had this faint ringing that comes and goes."
quests.correctAnswer: Hearing Loss, Ringing in the Ears
quests.hint: One symptom shows up specifically in noisy settings, and the other is a sound the patient hears.
quests.explanation: Needing repeats in noisy rooms points to early Hearing Loss, plus the separate symptom Ringing in the Ears.
medicalVocab: Hearing Loss, Ringing in the Ears

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: In the exam room, the patient says: "I've had this persistent itch on my lower legs that's worse at night, with no visible rash that I can see, and I've also had some trouble sleeping because of it."
quests.hint: The patient specifically says there's no visible rash - that rules out one tempting option.
quests.explanation: An itch with no visible rash is simply Itching, and the resulting sleep loss is Insomnia.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: Patient says: "I've had this deep ache in both hips that's worse first thing in the morning, easing somewhat as the day goes on, and I've also noticed some stiffness in my hands."
quests.hint: One symptom is centered in the hips, and the other is in the hands.
quests.explanation: Morning ache in both hips is Hip Pain, and the separate hand symptom is Joint Stiffness.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: The doctor asks about sleep, and the patient says: "I fall asleep fine, but I wake up multiple times a night and can't always tell why, and I've been dragging through my afternoons as a result."
quests.hint: One symptom is about the sleep itself, and the other is the daytime result.
quests.explanation: Waking up repeatedly at night is Insomnia, and dragging through afternoons is Fatigue.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: "I've had this odd sensation like my heart pauses for a beat before racing to catch up, a few times a day, and I've felt a bit more anxious than usual because of it," the patient tells the doctor.
quests.hint: One symptom is the heart sensation itself, and the other is the emotional reaction.
quests.explanation: A pausing, catching-up heartbeat is Heart Palpitations, and the worry it causes is Anxiety.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: At the clinic, the patient says: "I've had this crawling sensation in my legs that only happens in the evening, making it hard to sit still through a movie, and I've also had trouble falling asleep because of it."
quests.hint: One symptom is an urge to move in the evening, and the other is its effect at bedtime.
quests.explanation: An evening urge to move the legs is Restless Legs, and the resulting sleep trouble is Insomnia.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: During the check-up, the patient explains: "My voice has been noticeably different for a couple of weeks now, rougher than my normal cold-related hoarseness, and I've also had a mild, persistent cough."
quests.hint: One symptom is about how the voice sounds, and the other is a separate, ongoing cough.
quests.explanation: A rougher-than-usual voice is a Hoarse Voice, plus a separate Persistent Cough, described simply as a Cough.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: In the exam room, the patient says: "I've had these brief spells where the room tilts and I have to grab something to steady myself, lasting maybe thirty seconds, and afterward I usually feel a bit nauseous."
quests.hint: The room actually tilting is more specific than general unsteadiness.
quests.explanation: The room tilting is Vertigo, a precise type of Dizziness, followed by Nausea.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: Patient says: "I've had this constant low hum of anxiety that I can't quite place, along with a racing mind at bedtime that keeps me up."
quests.hint: One symptom is an ongoing emotional state, and the other is about a racing mind at night.
quests.explanation: A constant, hard-to-place worry is Anxiety, and a racing mind at bedtime causes Insomnia.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: The doctor asks about the cough, and the patient says: "It's dry, comes in fits, and gets worse when I laugh or lie down flat, and my throat feels raw afterward from all the coughing."
quests.hint: One symptom is the cough itself, and the other is the result of coughing so much.
quests.explanation: A dry, fit-like cough is Cough, and the raw feeling afterward is Sore Throat.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: "I've had this puffiness around my eyes every morning that fades by midday, and I've also felt unusually thirsty," the patient tells the doctor.
quests.hint: One symptom is about the eyes in the morning, and the other is a constant feeling.
quests.explanation: Morning puffiness is Puffy Eyes, and constant thirst is Excessive Thirst.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: At the clinic, the patient says: "I've had this tender lump under my jaw that's been there about a week, and I've felt run down the whole time."
quests.hint: One symptom is a lump under the jaw, and the other is low energy.
quests.explanation: A tender lump under the jaw is Swollen Glands, and feeling run down is Fatigue.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: During the check-up, the patient explains: "My fingers turn white then blue in the cold, then bright red as they warm back up, which is new for me, and I've also noticed some mild stiffness in those same fingers."
quests.correctAnswer: Cold Hands and Feet, Joint Stiffness
quests.hint: One symptom is about color and temperature, and the other is about moving the fingers.
quests.explanation: Color changes in the cold fit Cold Hands and Feet, plus separate Joint Stiffness in the fingers.
medicalVocab: Cold Hands and Feet, Joint Stiffness

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: In the exam room, the patient says: "I've had this dull throb in one temple that shows up most afternoons, and everyday sounds have started to feel too loud."
quests.hint: A one-sided throb combined with a reaction to sound points to a more specific type of headache.
quests.explanation: A one-sided throb with sound sensitivity fits Migraine more precisely than a general Tension Headache.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: Patient says: "I've had this persistent soreness at the back of my throat that's not quite pain, more like irritation, and I've been clearing my throat all day."
quests.hint: One symptom is the irritation itself, and the other is the repeated action it causes.
quests.explanation: Ongoing throat irritation is a Sore Throat, and constant throat-clearing is a form of Cough.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: The doctor asks how long the swelling has lasted, and the patient says: "About five days now, and it's spread from my ankle up toward my shin a little, and I've had some mild discomfort when I walk on it."
quests.hint: One symptom is about size, and the other is about pain while walking.
quests.explanation: Five days of spreading puffiness is Swelling, and discomfort while walking is Ankle Pain.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: "I've had these episodes of feeling suddenly overheated and sweaty, then chilled a few minutes later, several times a day," the patient tells the doctor.
quests.hint: One symptom is sudden heat, and the other is the chill that follows.
quests.explanation: Sudden overheating fits Hot Flashes, and the chill afterward fits Chills.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: At the clinic, the patient says: "I've had this persistent dryness in my eyes that artificial tears barely touch anymore, and my vision blurs by late afternoon."
quests.hint: One symptom is about moisture, and the other is about clarity later in the day.
quests.explanation: Dryness that tears don't fix is Dry Eyes, and unclear sight later on is Blurred Vision.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: During the check-up, the patient explains: "I've noticed distinct patches of hair thinning on my scalp, not just general shedding, over the past couple of months, and I've also felt more fatigued than usual during this time."
quests.hint: One symptom is about hair, and the other is about energy over the same period.
quests.explanation: Distinct thinning patches are Hair Loss, occurring alongside separate Fatigue.

quests.instruction: Select the two symptoms that best match what the patient describes.
quests.prompt: In the exam room, the patient says: "I've had this ache deep in my ear that gets worse when I yawn or chew, along with some fullness on that same side."
quests.hint: One symptom is pain triggered by jaw movement, and the other is a blocked feeling.
quests.explanation: Ear pain that worsens with chewing is an Earache, and the blocked feeling is Ear Fullness.
